working_geometry_plain: The working geometry is a finite response quotient carried by PEPS3D anchors. Finite spinor-derived site densities are probed by a finite effect family; sites with identical finite response vectors are quotient-equivalent. The quotient classes live on explicit site, edge, face, and cell anchors in K=(V,E,F,C). Local edge density cuts provide QIT entropy readouts. This is still only L0 response/effect/path quotient geometry, not the physical manifold.
